stem: Crop waste from a problem area is being carried through a clean propagation room on the way to disposal. What is the best interpretation?
choices: The route creates an avoidable biosecurity pathway and should be redesigned according to facility procedure
The route is acceptable because waste is no longer living plant material
The route matters only if the waste is wet
The route improves sanitation by exposing staff to the waste before disposal
rationale: Movement of waste through cleaner areas can create unnecessary contamination pathways. Workflow design should separate or control higher-risk material movement.
